scope: Selected historical component evidence, NOT a whole-Dusart runtime forecast.
host: Two AArch64 Neoverse-N1 cores; single-run wall times with warm dependencies.
revision_limitations: The Xi generated source digest is recorded below. Full experiment commits were not recorded in the other reports; do not infer them from the release commit. Report hashes identify the source evidence, not independently reproducible benchmark inputs.

primality.scope: Individual certificates, not counting completeness; includes import/process cost.

packed_count.scope: Actual PrimeCert sieve equality, IsSieve, checked count, exact Nat.primeCounting. Includes complete Lean process, axiom audit and olean. External generation excluded from reported Lean time. 55-second/6-GiB safeguard, no thread caps. No theta/log trace or zero verification; not a whole-workflow projection.

packed_convolution.scope: Actual nonnegative integer convolution from packed-only data. Proves decoding, coefficient mask bounds, no carries and product semantics. Not signed/complex convolution, FFT, error or zero certificate. No olean output or thread caps.

meissel.scope: Heuristic coverage mesh; unmeasured shared-table proofs and theta/zero certificates excluded.
meissel.method: 64 equal-count strata, one midpoint operation census per stratum

external_signs.scope: External Arb interval evaluations only. Numerical proposals are NOT Lean checked, no global RH/completeness or six-hour projection. Zero search and endpoint-sign evaluation are timed separately; nearby zero indices selected only by a floating main term. No thread settings changed; no claim of high-height worst-case cost.

platt_scenario.scope: NONRIGOROUS analytic screen only, using derived conservative C and incomplete-Gamma majorants, shifted-frequency alias margin, all seven grid errors and C1/C3 interpolation. No numeric rounding budget, verified signs, continuous height bands, rare fallback counts, Turing padding, or full-domain time projection. The 1e-8 allocations are chosen, not proved sufficient. Fixed top-height profile/window count is a comparison scenario.

xi_low_block.scope: complete moment/Fourier/error/sign/ordered-count block; not global completeness
xi_low_block.limitations: warm dependencies; sampled RSS can miss peaks/double-count shared pages; no high-height or whole-range timing extrapolation
